## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the `--json` path detection before merge: the default destination only works when `--json` is the last argument, so `--json` placed ahead of `--junit` fails or writes to a wrong path.

## Changes
The pull request adds a `--json` option to `parse_args` in `app/cli.py`, defaulting to `results.json` when no path follows, and adds `write_reports`, which writes each report to its parsed destination. It also adds `tests/test_cli.py` covering the JSON default, an explicit JSON path, and the required `--junit` path.

## Critical
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Treat a following `--` flag as no path for `--json` — `parse_args(["--json", "--junit", "x.xml"])` raises `ValueError("unknown option: x.xml")`, because line 15 takes any following argument as the destination. `["--json", "--junit"]` returns `{"json": "--junit"}`, so `write_reports` writes a file named `--junit` and drops the JUnit option. — Combining a default-destination `--json` with `--junit`, the use the description names, fails or writes to the wrong file unless `--json` comes last. — Fix: Apply the `startswith("--")` check from `app/cli.py:7` before consuming the next argument, and extend `test_json_default_and_explicit_path` with `--json` ahead of `--junit`.
